annotations.title: Find pictures with a free licence

description: Searches Wikimedia Commons and Openverse (Flickr, museums, archives) for photos and artwork of a real thing the film names: a person, a place, a building, a product, an event, an animal. Only pictures a sold video may use come back (CC BY, CC BY-SA, CC0, public domain), each with its size, licence, creator, the credit line its licence asks for and its page. Free. Returns a labelled sheet to look at; bring one into the video with fetch_picture.

limit.description: How many pictures to return, 1 to 12

q.description: What to find, in a few English words (the archives are in English): "Marie Curie portrait", "Jakarta skyline night"

source.description: Where to search: both archives, Wikimedia Commons only or Openverse only
